children: Major European stock indexes are higher on Friday as oil prices retreat on hopes for progress between the U.S. and Iran to end the war in the Middle East.
Negotiators are exploring a phased path out of the war that would involve reopening the Strait of Hormuz, sources close to the talks told Reuters.
Crude prices slipped, helping European shares on Friday.
is up 0.6% and heading for a 0.8% weekly gain, its first positive week in four.
Breadth is positive, with rising stocks outnumbering declining stocks by about 2.5 to 1.
The energy sector (.SXEP) lags as oil prices have slipped. Bank (.SX7P) and miners (.SXPP) are the top gainers.
